test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements about the India–Japan strategic and economic partnership are correct?
1) Japan is India’s 5th-largest FDI source, with over $43 billion invested and key roles in metro and bullet train projects.
2) CEPA (2011) led to 11 Japanese industrial townships in 8 Indian states and 1,400+ Japanese firms in India.
3) CEPA launched a Digital Skills Exchange Program on AI and Kaizen-based public governance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 and 2 only**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__

• **Statement 1 is correct:** **Japan** is currently the **5th-largest** source of **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)** in India. Between April 2000 and March 2024, cumulative FDI from Japan reached approximately **$41.5 billion to $43 billion**. Japan has played a pivotal role in India's infrastructure development, providing technical and financial assistance for various **Metro Rail projects** (like Delhi and Mumbai) and the prestigious **Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail (MAHSR)**, commonly known as the **Bullet Train** project.

• **Statement 2 is correct:** The **Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)**, signed in **2011**, has been a cornerstone of bilateral trade. It facilitated the establishment of **Japanese Industrial Townships (JITs)** to provide ready-to-use infrastructure for Japanese companies. Currently, there are **12 JITs** across various Indian states (including Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Andhra Pradesh). Furthermore, the number of **Japanese companies** registered in India has grown significantly, exceeding **1,400**.

• **Statement 3 is incorrect:** While India and Japan do cooperate on **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** and **Kaizen-based governance**, these initiatives were not launched under the **2011 CEPA**. The **India-Japan Digital Partnership (IJDP)** was specifically launched in **October 2018** to focus on **Digital Transformation**, **AI**, and **IoT**. **Kaizen** principles are promoted through the **Japan-India Institute for Manufacturing (JIM)** and other skill development programs, which are separate from the trade-focused CEPA.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The relationship between India and Japan was elevated to a **Special Strategic and Global Partnership** in 2014.

• Japan is the largest provider of **Official Development Assistance (ODA)** to India, supporting projects in power, transport, and environmental sectors.

• Both nations are members of the **QUAD** (alongside the USA and Australia) and the **Supply Chain Resilience Initiative (SCRI)**, aimed at diversifying global supply chains.

• The **Act East Forum**, established in 2017, focuses on the development of India's **North Eastern Region (NER)** through Japanese investment and connectivity projects.
</ul
